name: InsightIQ
description: Rebuilt InsightIQ as a local MCP server that gives AI agents such as Claude Code and Claude Desktop tool-based access to real FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data) series and observations.
Published and versioned the server as insightiq-mcp on npm, distributed via npx so any MCP client can install and run it with zero setup beyond a FRED API key.
Designed search, retrieval, and tag-discovery tools that return only validated, real FRED series and raw observations, leaving all analysis and explanation to the calling agent's own LLM.
Built an MCP-level eval suite measuring retrieval recall against a benchmark question set (45.3% on raw questions vs. 62.4% with curated query plans) and wired GitHub Actions CI for syntax checks.

name: TravelGlow
description: Built an end-to-end skincare planning platform that combines YouCam skin analysis with destination weather to generate personalized skin forecasts, packing lists, and product recommendations.

Integrated YouCam, WeatherAPI.com, and Gemini via normalized adapters and asynchronous polling, feeding a versioned rules-based engine that evaluates 5 skin and climate risk categories while restricting generative AI to explaining validated results rather than making decisions.

Developed a PostgreSQL data model with 9 automatic migrations, traceable forecast inputs, and a curated catalog of 20 relevance-ranked products, plus privacy-conscious in-memory processing for selfie uploads.

Containerized the React frontend, Express API, and PostgreSQL database with Docker Compose and production nginx configuration, backed by 21 automated tests covering forecast rules, ranking, and analytics.

name: Releasetrain.io
description: Developed an NLP pipeline for ReleaseTrain.io that transformed 4,000+ labeled Reddit posts into structured signals for identifying software-release and update-related discussions.
Trained and evaluated TF-IDF-based logistic regression and SVM classifiers using stratified validation and minority-class oversampling to address imbalanced community data.
Built a reusable inference workflow that cleans incoming posts and enriches JSON records with predicted labels, confidence scores, and timestamps.
Integrated the classification results into ReleaseTrain.io's broader software-release and security-analysis workflow.

name: Sproutly
description: Owned React and TypeScript frontend development on a four-person IoT team, building responsive dashboards, authentication, plant-management workflows, sensor-history views, and reusable components.
Integrated JWT-secured FastAPI endpoints through shared Axios services and implemented automatic refresh, loading, and error states for monitoring current and historical moisture readings.
Collaborated across a Raspberry Pi, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, and Azure stack to support four sensors, 60-second sampling, weather enrichment, offline SQLite storage, and batched synchronization.
Maintained ESLint and Azure Pipelines CI workflows, resolved integration issues, and supported consistent Docker- and Nginx-based deployments.

name: Emergency Traffic Priority System
description: Built a SUMO and TraCI traffic-control system that detects approaching emergency vehicles and uses real-time vehicle, lane, speed, and detector data to coordinate lane clearance and signal priority.
Implemented detector-triggered intersection control that dynamically switches traffic-light phases and directs surrounding vehicles away from an emergency vehicle's route.
Developed a reinforcement-learning agent that evaluates nearby traffic, lane availability, and intersection distance to select maintain-lane, left-lane, or right-lane actions.
Standardized simulation runners and configuration using repository-relative paths and environment variables, enabling reproducible experiments across different machines.
